intro: Build the thesis. Choose the right piece for each blank.
sentence_frame: ___ threatened absolute monarchy, because ___, which meant ___.

tiles.text: thinkers like Locke argued that power comes from the people
the philosophes argued that kings rule by divine right
the philosophes wanted to end all government
a ruler who broke the deal could lose the right to rule
kings held more power than ever before
people had to obey any ruler, no matter what

correct_sentence: Enlightenment ideas threatened absolute monarchy, because thinkers like Locke argued that power comes from the people, which meant a ruler who broke the deal could lose the right to rule.
hints: Divine right was the kings' claim, not the threat to it.
Locke said power comes from the people. What happens if a ruler breaks their side of the deal?
rationale: A thesis takes a side and gives a reason. Enlightenment ideas said power comes from the people, so a ruler who abused it could lose it. That's a real threat to kings who claimed divine right.
